name: serviceLogVolume
description: OpenTelemetry log counts over time by service and severity (requires Import OpenTelemetry services)

config.postBody: {{ (() => { const svc = dataSource.otelServiceField || 'resource.service.name.keyword'; const ts = dataSource.otelTimestampField || '@timestamp'; const sev = dataSource.otelSeverityField || 'severity.number'; const names = (typeof service !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(service)) ? service.map((o) => [].concat(o.rawId)[0]) : []; const tf = typeof timeframe !== 'undefined' ? timeframe : null; const span = (tf && tf.start && tf.enum !== 'none') ? { gte: tf.start, lte: tf.end, format: 'strict_date_optional_time' } : { gte: 'now-24h' }; const filter = [ { range: { [ts]: span } } ]; if (names.length) { filter.push({ terms: { [svc]: names } }); } return { size: 0, track_total_hits: false, query: { bool: { filter: filter } }, aggs: { overTime: { auto_date_histogram: { field: ts, buckets: 60 }, aggs: { services: { terms: { field: svc, size: 100 }, aggs: { severity: { range: { field: sev, ranges: [ { key: 'Unspecified', to: 1 }, { key: 'Trace', from: 1, to: 5 }, { key: 'Debug', from: 5, to: 9 }, { key: 'Info', from: 9, to: 13 }, { key: 'Warn', from: 13, to: 17 }, { key: 'Error', from: 17, to: 21 }, { key: 'Fatal', from: 21 } ] } } } } } } } }; })() }}
